other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Meghalaya
Applicant must be engaged in building or other construction works
Applicant must be registered under the Meghalaya Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Applicant must have an active membership of the Board
Benefit is limited to a maximum of two times per worker
Eligibility applies only during the maternity period
benefits_summary: Registered women construction workers receive a financial assistance of ₹1,000 as maternity benefits during their maternity period.
